findings.reason: the node would ship a second misleading message in place of the one it was sent to replace; the text must name the missing `total` (or whichever measure of `_review_is_complete` failed) rather than missing dimensions.
findings.text: §10 says "A record whose score is incomplete says the dimensions are missing", but both cited runs' records carry all six dimensions and fail only on an absent integer `total`, so the message it prescribes would be false for exactly the two runs that motivated the section

findings.reason: a fixture that drops a dimension passes while the total-absent record its own evidence cites still produces the wrong refusal.
findings.text: the done-when builds "one review run per failing condition" but the section lists five reasons at plan:343-350 and the Deliverable names four at plan:352, so the node cannot tell how many cases to build and the fixture it omits is the incomplete-review case, which is the one the evidence actually exhibits

findings.reason: a coordinator dispatching from the followup's order never reaches §10, and a section that is never dispatched is work that is never done.
findings.text: the driving followup orders "§2 and §3 ... §4, §6, §7's four nodes, §8 and §9's four nodes", and names §5's wait, but never places §10, whose section declares only `depends-on` s3 and shares no write path with any of them
